# SpeechGen.io

> AI-powered platform converting text to speech with 5000+ neural voices and supporting reverse transcription from audio/video to text.

SpeechGen.io offers comprehensive speech synthesis and transcription tools with support for 146+ languages, SSML markup customization, and flexible pay-as-you-go pricing. The platform serves content creators, educators, and developers seeking neural voice generation and audio-to-text conversion capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-Speech (TTS)
- Neural Voices
- SSML Markup
- Speech Synthesis
- Audio Transcription
- YouTube Transcription
- Pay-as-You-Go Pricing
- Multilingual Support
- Voice Emphasis
- Subtitle Conversion
- PDF-to-Audio
- Video-to-Text
- AI Voice Generation
- Character Limits
- SSML Tags

## Core Products

- [Realistic Text to Speech converter & AI Voice generator](https://speechgen.io): SpeechGen.io homepage: AI-powered text-to-speech with 5000+ neural voices
- [SRT to Audio & Speech Converter — Subtitle to MP3](https://speechgen.io/en/subs): Convert SRT subtitles to synced AI voiceover in 146 languages with timestamps
- [Transcribe Audio to Text in Seconds — with AI Accuracy](https://speechgen.io/en/transcribe): Convert speech to text with AI accuracy, supporting YouTube and cloud storage
- [YouTube AI Transcript with Speaker Identification](https://speechgen.io/en/transcribe/youtube): Transcribe YouTube videos to text with 95% accuracy and SRT subtitle export
- [Video to Text Converter - Upload & Transcribe Video Files Online](https://speechgen.io/en/transcribe/video): Convert MP4, AVI, MOV video files to text with 95% accuracy in 150+ languages
- [PDF to Speech and MP3 - Transform Documents into Audio](https://speechgen.io/en/pdf): Convert PDF documents to audio MP3 with SpeechGen's PDF-to-speech converter
- [Convert Word DOCX to Speech audio Audio - Document to Voice Online](https://speechgen.io/en/docx): Convert Microsoft Word DOCX files to speech audio with professional narration
- [Child Text to Speech - kids ai voice generator](https://speechgen.io/en/child-tts): AI-powered child voice generator with kid-friendly voices for text-to-speech

- [How to Modify Intonation, Pose Questions, and Emphasize Words in Text](https://speechgen.io/en/node/intonation): SSML guide for controlling intonation, pitch, and prosody in TTS output
- [SSML Emphasis Tag Guide: Enhance Your Text-to-Speech Output with Voice Emphasis](https://speechgen.io/en/node/emphasis): SSML emphasis tag guide for enhancing voice quality in text-to-speech
- [How to insert a pause for Text to Speech Generator](https://speechgen.io/en/node/pausa): Tutorial on inserting pauses and breaks in SpeechGen TTS synthesis
- [Multi voice text to speech synthesis with dialogues](https://speechgen.io/en/node/multi-voice): Guide to creating multi-voice dialogues with SSML in SpeechGen TTS
